description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/seek-operator-spelling: no valid spelling was included, so all sixteen failing spellings had no control for a working Seek on the same recordset shape. On a fresh table-type recordset over F with Index PK_F, for each comparison argument [= (control) ;; < (control) ;; <= (control) ;; >= (control) ;; > (control) ;; => ;; =< ;; != ;; <=> ;;  =  ;; >=  ;; "" ;; Like ;; EQ ;; ~ ;; Null ;; Empty ;; Missing ;; Long 0 ;; Long 61 ;; Boolean True] (the five valid operators first, as controls): read ID (the start); Seek with that argument and the key Long 4; read Errors, NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID; close. Asks which operator spellings and argument types the method accepts and which row each selects, with the valid operators beside them on the same shape. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
